name: Nuclear risk
value: No US–Russia limits; Iran strike threats
summary: New START lapsed in Feb with no replacement; Zaporizhzhia lost off-site power 8 Nov; US threatens Iran sites
state: No US–Russia treaty has limited strategic nuclear forces since New START expired on 5 Feb (AP via Anchorage Daily News). Zaporizhzhia lost all off-site power for the 27th time on 8 Nov before it was restored (Anadolu). President Trump has threatened further strikes on Iran, and the White House dismissed a commentator's claim of nuclear planning (Gulf News). Searches on 11 Nov found no nuclear test, alert-level change or explicit threat of nuclear use.
for_you: No change in UK public advice. Official guidance on radiation emergencies comes from UKHSA and the government's emergency alerts service.
rubric_hit: Arms-control lapse without replacement (New START) = Watch; no test, alert-level change or threatened use

sources.title: Anchorage Daily News (AP) — Half a century of US-Russian arms control ends with expiration of New START nuclear pact
Anadolu — Ukraine's Zaporizhzhya nuclear plant loses all external power for 27th time
Gulf News — Could Trump launch a nuclear strike on Iran's Pickaxe Mountain?

why: Nuclear use anywhere would be a civilisational shock; arms-control treaties are weaker than at any time since the 1960s.
drivers: Threats in active wars, testing, doctrine changes, arms-control collapse, proliferation.

rubric.alert: A nuclear test, changes in deployment/alert levels, or threatened use in an active conflict.
rubric.watch: Explicit threats, unusual exercises, doctrine changes, or arms-control lapses without replacement.
rubric.normal: No explicit nuclear threats or tests; arms-control dialogue active.
